chunks: He said: 'They shall wake up repenting soon.'

key_terms.لَيُصْبِحُنَ: they shall wake up / become in the morning

ai.seo_question: What will the disbelievers feel when they wake up on the Day of Judgment?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the suddenness of divine reckoning, contrasting the disbelievers' complacency with the abrupt onset of regret. It serves as a warning that the opportunity for repentance vanishes once the reality of the Hereafter becomes undeniable, a theme emphasized by scholars like Allamah Tabatabai in *Al-Mizan*. This moment of realization is not merely emotional but a structural shift in their existence, confirming the inevitability of divine justice.
